title.narrative: Support to South Africa on the local production of an HIV/Aids vaccine and active pharmaceutical ingredients (API)

description.narrative: The project forms part of the M <(>&<)>E component of an ongoing bilateral TC project between Italy and South Africa that supports the latter#s efforts to combat the HIV/Aids challenge with advisory and capacity-building assistance in three areas: (1) Strengthening of a network of clinical sites and laboratories at provincial level, particularly in the HIV/AIDS sector; (2) Support the setup of a GMP line of production to manufacture vaccines in South Africa; and (3) Development and conduct of a Phase II therapeutic clinical trial with the Tat vaccine developed by Italy#s National Institute for Health (ISS). Fundamentally, UNIDO was entrusted with managing an International Scientific Advisory Committee (ISAC) tasked to carry out a full-fledged evaluation of the Italy/South Africa project. In addition, following an overhaul of the originally agreed work plan, UNIDO#s specific contribution formally agreed in mid-2014 relates to three activity clusters, i.e. (1) training program for MCC staff on the review of medicines regulatory submissions; (2) capacity-building for The Biovac Institute; and (3) conduct of a multi-stakeholder dialogue meeting to bridge training offers of higher educational institutions [HEI] with skills acquisition needs of pharmaceutical manufacturers.
